ai.title: Assistant
ai.subtitle: Ask about the host you are working on.

empty.title: Nothing asked yet.
empty.body: A question can carry the last lines of the terminal on screen, and the assistant can use this application's tools when it needs to look at the host itself.

noProvider.title: No provider configured
noProvider.body: The assistant speaks to a model service you configure. Nothing has been configured on this installation yet.

noKey.title: No key stored for this provider
noKey.body: The provider is configured, but no API key is stored for it — or the key was removed. Add one in the settings.

setup.locked: The vault is locked, so the panel cannot tell whether a key is stored. Unlock it to ask.

composer.hint: Enter sends; Shift+Enter starts a new line.
composer.clearFailed: The chat could not be cleared.

context.title: Terminal context
context.linesHint: How many lines of the terminal travel with a question. Zero attaches nothing.
context.empty: No terminal is on screen, so nothing will be attached.
context.limits: Stripped of control sequences, with anything that looks like a credential replaced, and capped at {chars} characters.

settings.description: Where the assistant's questions go. The keys are kept in the vault, never in the settings file, and this window never reads one back.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: One entry per service. The active one is where a new question goes.
providers.empty: No provider has been configured yet.
providers.activeHint: The provider a new conversation starts with. "First configured" applies while nothing is chosen.
providers.name: Name
providers.nameHint: What this entry is called in the list. Nothing is sent with it.
providers.baseUrlHint: Where requests go. Only https is accepted, except for a server on this machine, which may use http on 127.0.0.1, localhost or ::1.
providers.modelHint: The model name the service expects.
providers.maxOutputHint: The most tokens one answer may produce.
providers.keyHint: Written to the vault and never shown again. Leave it empty to keep the key that is stored.
providers.keyLocked: The vault is locked, so whether a key is stored cannot be told.
providers.removeMessage: Its entry and the key stored for it go away. Sessions are not affected.

kind.localHint: A server on this machine or the network that speaks the OpenAI shape: Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio.

context.title: Terminal context
context.enabled: Attach the terminal to a question

privacy.title: What leaves this machine
privacy.body: Only the question you typed, the terminal lines shown in the preview, and what a tool call returns. Keys, vault passwords, sync tokens and private keys are never sent — the preview is the exact text that travels, with anything that looks like a credential replaced before it leaves.
